name: Wet Blue ~Poolside no Tenshi-tachi~
original_name: WET BLUE～プールサイドの天使たち～
source:
Sera opens her heart and body to two girls who are full of mysteries...
Deep blue sadness brings back memories of an ugly incident in the past.
These girls in school swimsuits have souls in pain and are waiting for pleasure to bring them sexual healing.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180826085010/http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039003.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
世良向两名谜团重重的少女敞开了心扉与身体……
深蓝色的忧伤，唤起了过往某桩丑恶事件的记忆。
这些身着校园泳装的少女心灵饱受煎熬，正期盼着快感为她们带来肉体上的抚慰与治愈。
